name: codetrust
description: Flags risky patterns in AI-generated Python code inline. Runs locally, sends nothing anywhere.

codetrust.scope.description: insertions: scan only blocks that appear at once (accepted suggestions, pastes). file: rescan the whole file on every change.

codetrust.useLocalSemgrep.description: Scan with the Semgrep installed on this computer, using the rules shipped with CodeTrust. If Semgrep cannot run, the built-in rules are used.

codetrust.semgrepPath.description: The Semgrep program to run: a name on PATH or a full path. Only user (machine) settings can set this, so a project cannot choose which program runs.
